rationale: A is the better overall refactor because its amount grouping is correct for arbitrarily large values and its fmt-based column alignment does not panic when content exceeds the nominal width. B has stronger date validation and Unicode-aware truncation, but formatAmount incorrectly groups amounts with more than six integer digits (for example, 1,234,567 becomes 1234,567), and padLeft can panic for amounts wider than the column. A still has robustness gaps—byte-based description truncation can split UTF-8 and date validation checks only shape—but B's monetary-formatting defect is more central to the ledger's behavior.
